# OCI DNS

**Parity grade: B** · SDK `github.com/oracle/oci-go-sdk/v65@v65.126.2` · last audited 2026-11-01 (`15447c03a`)

### Known gaps

- DNSSEC is state only: dnssecState is stored, but no keys are generated, dnssecConfig is never returned, answers are unsigned, and StageZoneDnssecKeyVersion and PromoteZoneDnssecKeyVersion are not routed (needs key generation, RRSIG/NSEC signing in authority.go:answerQuestion and the dnssecConfig wire in zones.go zoneWire).
- Private DNS is not served: resolver endpoint addresses, forwarding rules, views attached to resolvers and PRIVATE zones affect no query, because a data-plane query carries no VCN identity (authority.go:answerQuestion sees only the UDP source address and globalZoneFor skips non-GLOBAL zones). resolutionMode TRANSPARENT and RTYPE_TRANSPARENT are stored only.
